reason: My bank app already shows my transfer history, so paying to track the same slips again feels like paying twice for one thing. I would use the free trial to see if the Shortcut actually saves me time, but I would not keep it after that.
objection: I do not see what this shows me that K PLUS does not already show, and I do not want to hand my slips and statements to another app just to get a chart.
would_change_my_mind: If it combined my K PLUS, Bangkok Bank and credit-card spending in one view that my bank apps cannot show, and the trial proved the Shortcut saves me real typing.
